messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a toggle swap for the feature flag `new-routing` during a quiet window today. Target flip at 16:00 UTC (4pm). Goal: enable KV-prefetch for a short run and validate no regressions. Looking for an owner to trigger, someone to run smoke checks, and a rollback owner. Canary plan below.

james: I can own the trigger and monitor cluster side. I'll be at my desk at 16:00.

aya: I’ll run the smoke harness and sanity checks. I’ll validate: health endpoints, top-level error rates, and tail logs for exceptions. Will post a quick status at +5m and +15m.

devops-bot: scheduled reminder set for 2005004321 (16:00 UTC). Automated toggle not configured — manual flip required.

maria: Plan details: canary 10% for 5m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% if green. Canary gates: error-rate <= 1% and p95 latency < 150ms for the canary cohort. If either gate fails, immediate rollback to safe-default.

olga: Rollback command ready. Use the config service to revert the flag to safe default (`off`). Example:

```
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/v1/flags/new-routing
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"value": false, "reason": "rollback - canary fail"}'
```

olga: Also, config toggle will emit an event to `events/flags` topic — make sure consumers have processed the change.

simon-oncall: I’ll be standing by for the window. If errors spike >5% or p95 crosses 200ms, tag me and I’ll coordinate rollback. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/flag-rollbacks (quick checklist at top).

james: Noted. I’ll run the flip at 16:00 and post the toggle confirmation (timestamp + rollout percentage). Aya — I’ll DM you the canary cohort IDs so you can slice the dashboard.

aya: Got it. I’ll start the smoke script right after the 10% flip and post the first pass in this thread.

maria: Thanks all — final checklist:
- james: trigger at 16:00 and post confirmation
- aya: smoke checks at +2m, +5m, +15m
- olga: rollback command ready and accessible
- simon-oncall: available for escalations

maria: If everything is green I’ll escalate to do the 50% step at +5m. If no objections, proceed as planned. :thumbsup:

james: :thumbsup: will keep a quick log snippet and link to the trace capture if anything odd shows up.
